name: Top-Down ARPG / Tactics
description: Optimized for Top-Down Action RPGs, Roguelikes, and Tactics games (Zelda, Diablo, Final Fantasy Tactics). Multi-directional 8-way and 4-way spritesheets with auto-mirroring.
prompt_prefix: top-down RPG sprite, bird-eye 45-degree angled view, visible head shoulders and feet, grid-aligned collision base, crisp clean pixel edges
negative_prompt: side view, platformer, horizon, sky, face close up, bust portrait, cut off limbs, stacked heads
features: Auto-baked Normal & Depth maps for dynamic lighting
